symbols.name: Scanner
symbols.doc: Stream token and line scanner for string parsing and standard input reading.

members.name: fromString
members.doc: Creates a Scanner reading from the provided string.

members.name: fromStdin
members.doc: Creates a Scanner reading from standard input.

members.name: scanInt
members.doc: Convenience method to prompt and read a single integer from stdin.

members.name: scanDouble
members.doc: Convenience method to prompt and read a single float/double from stdin.

members.name: scanLine
members.doc: Convenience method to prompt and read a single line from stdin.

members.name: scanWord
members.doc: Convenience method to prompt and read a single whitespace-delimited word from stdin.

members.name: next
members.doc: Finds and returns the next complete token according to the delimiter pattern.

members.name: nextLine
members.doc: Advances this scanner past the current line and returns the line that was skipped.

members.name: nextInt
members.doc: Scans the next token as an integer (default base 10, or 2, 8, 16).

members.name: nextDouble
members.doc: Scans the next token as a floating-point number.

members.name: nextBool
members.doc: Scans the next token as a boolean ('true' or 'false', case-insensitive).

members.name: hasNext
members.doc: Returns true if this scanner has another token in its input.

members.name: hasNextLine
members.doc: Returns true if there is another line in the input of this scanner.

members.name: hasNextInt
members.doc: Returns true if the next token in this scanner's input can be interpreted as an int.

members.name: hasNextDouble
members.doc: Returns true if the next token in this scanner's input can be interpreted as a double.

members.name: hasNextBool
members.doc: Returns true if the next token in this scanner's input can be interpreted as a bool.

members.name: useDelimiter
members.doc: Sets this scanner's delimiting pattern (e.g. ',', '\t', '|'). Returns this scanner for chaining.

members.name: getDelimiter
members.doc: Returns the delimiter string currently used by this scanner.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Resets the scanner position back to the beginning of input (string mode only).

members.name: allTokens
members.doc: Scans and collects all remaining tokens into an array.

members.name: allLines
members.doc: Scans and collects all remaining lines into an array.

members.name: close
members.doc: Closes this scanner and releases associated resources.
